title: Grateful Dead Live at Great American Music Hall on 1975-08-13
source: FM Source:  SBD>FM>MC>DAT>WAV>SHN SBD Source: MSR>R(2)>C>DAT>WAV>SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent FM broadcast capture of a tight 1975 performance with smoking Slipknot! and stellar Blues for Allah.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear FM broadcast sound, even sounding better than older CD releases. The band delivers super‑tight jams despite being on a break, with highlights like Slipknot!, Stronger Than Dirt, Sage & Spirit, and Blues For Allah*. Overall the show feels energetic and well‑balanced.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are highly positive (average 4.75 stars), highlighting both superb audio quality and a strong musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Great FM broadcast source; crisp, clear, and reportedly better than earlier CD releases.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Even though the band was on a break, the set flows with super‑tight jams and high energy throughout.
